faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the JSCPS Social Worker Member recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the JSCPS Social Worker Member posts is 10th October 2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the eligibility criteria for the Social Worker Member post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a degree from a recognized university with at least 7 years of experience working with children in education, health, protection, or welfare activities. Alternatively, a practicing professional in child psychology, psychiatry, social work, sociology, human development, or law, or a retired judicial officer is eligible.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Social Worker Member position is between 35 years and 60 years.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Social Worker Member post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 6 vacancies for the Social Worker Member post released by the Jharkhand State Child Protection Society.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Social Worker Member position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive an honorarium of Rs.2000 per sitting for the Social Worker Member post.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this job?
faq.answer: The application process for the JSCPS Social Worker Member recruitment is entirely online. Candidates must apply through the official website.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Social Worker Member role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a screening of application forms, evaluation by a selection committee, and a personal interaction.

faq.question: Q9. Which organization is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is being conducted by the Jharkhand State Child Protection Society (JSCPS).

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: The official notification and the online application link can be found in the "Important Links" section of this article. You can also visit the official website of JSCPS for more details.
